description: Two-car collision on the Parkway near the Darnall junction. Two occupants trapped, one unconscious. Fuel leaking.
Reports of shots fired outside a bar on Fitzalan Square. Two people injured, suspect seen leaving on foot towards Haymarket.
Fire on the 9th floor of a residential tower block in Broomhall, smoke spreading to floors above. Residents reported trapped on upper floors.
Chemical tanker leaking near Meadowhall. Strong smell, several workers from an adjacent warehouse report breathing difficulty.
Large fire in a block at Park Hill flats spreading across two floors. Two residents trapped on a balcony.
